sloka: दर्शनं चित्र कूटस्य मन्दाकिन्याश्च शोभने ।अधिकं पुरवासाच्च मन्ये च तव दर्शनात् ॥ २.९५.१२॥
transliteration: darśanaṁ citra kūṭasya mandākinyāśca śobhane ।adhikaṁ puravāsācca manye ca tava darśanāt ॥ 2.95.12॥

translations.english: My lovely Sita, I consider watching this mount Chitrakuta and river Mandakini in your presence more delightful than living in Ayodhya.
